name: Iizuka Chiaki
source: Kousuke's crush. He confess his love for her. Even though she was happy that he confess for her.She had to turn him down due to her getting married. Months later she divorces her husband. She also calls Shinohara by his first name and vis versa. She tries to not say his first name in front of other teachers.
